notes: There is now a first-run walkthrough: six pages covering what the app is and that it is local-only, how to log a set in shorthand, what the six attributes mean, what the muscle-balance figure and weak-point advice mean, where your data lives and how backups work, and the self-update path. Skippable from every page, and it never blocks the app loading

It runs EXACTLY ONCE. There is a versioned flag and no other re-show path, so it will come back only if a future version deliberately bumps it. Critically, there is NO migration that fills the flag in for existing users - a missing flag means show - which is precisely why you will see it once on this update, and a brand-new install also sees it once
